name: Olmstead 2005 descending - audio approximation
description: Auditory-only approximation of Olmstead (2005), Apparatus, journal p. 53: a 35-minute inhibitory AVS session beginning at 40 Hz and decreasing every 5 minutes to 14 Hz. Because the intermediate frequencies were not reported, this profile uses one continuous 40-to-14-Hz ramp instead of inventing step values. The app omits the white-light glasses and optional Disney story soundtrack; auditory carrier was unspecified, so both ears use a neutral 220 Hz. Not a treatment recommendation.
